text.description_html:
Global Door Controls TC205-BC-AL Door Closer

Global Series TC205 Door Closers provide narrow styling and installation versatility. They fit a common 9-1/6" x 3/4" mounting hole pattern and are packaged with wood and machine screws. Aluminum alloy shell, heavy spring size 5 with adjustable back check, adjustable latching speed, adjustable sweep speed and adjustable power shoe.

The TC205 is the highest rating Grade 1 certified and has a 25 Year Warranty. They are non handed and, for standard non-hold open or hold open applications. They can be mounted on regular and top jamb installations. An optional mounting bracket is available for parallel installations. Global Door Closer Accessories.

Specifications and Features Global TC205-BC-AL Door Closer

  • Adjustable Sweep Speed (closing speed)
  • Adjustable Latching Speed
  • Adjustable Back Check
  • Aluminum Alloy Shell
  • Closer Body Length: 9-7/8"
  • Horizontal Mounting Holes: 9-1/16"
  • Vertical Mounting Holes: 3/4"
  • Maximum Door Weight: 250 lbs
  • Maximum Door Size: 48" interior / 42" exterior
  • Non Handed
  • Grade 1 (Highest Grade)
  • UL 10C Approved
  • Spring Size: Heavy, Size 5
  • Finish: Aluminum
  • 25 Year Warranty
  • Dimensions (PDF)
